summary: Cheche Group Inc., a China-based auto insurance technology platform, filed a Form 6-K with exhibits including a press release dated August 5, 2026, announcing that Nasdaq confirmed on August 4, 2026, that the Company regained compliance with the Nasdaq minimum bid price requirement (Rule 5550(a)(2)). The closing bid price of its Class A ordinary shares remained at or above $1.00 per share for ten consecutive business days from July 21 to August 3, 2026, closing the matter. The filing is a routine compliance update, not a special situation. No deal terms are present.
